expectedRealization.rationale: DDR4 price/supply resets can affect one to two reporting cycles; 60d is the base horizon.

changeHypothesis.summary: By late Q2, DDR4 moved from tariff-driven restocking toward a more structural EOL/capacity-shortage mechanism. 兆易创新 was the strongest current-quality A-share expression, but the June physical price surge had not yet been directly converted into reported company earnings and the 60-day opportunity regime remained weak.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Repeated June specialist evidence showed supply reductions and large DDR4 contract-price increases.
disconfirmingEvidence: All physical supply evidence comes from one specialist origin.
Q1 company profit growth was only mid-teens and predated the June price surge.
60d basket excess was negative and only one of four names beat CSI300.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The June DDR4 shortage was increasingly visible, but the frozen company results still reflected pre-shortage Q1 economics.
expectations.thesisExpectation: H2 earnings should accelerate if the large DDR4 price reset transmits to product mix/margins.
expectations.measurableGap: Industry evidence is ahead of company financial evidence; this is precisely a proxy-to-realization gap.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Relative earnings quality plus H2 price/mix bridge versus memory peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Q1 profit growth was only 14.6%, while June industry prices accelerated materially.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: H2 ASP/mix lifts earnings revisions beyond Q1 run-rate.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: The June industry price reset must produce a measurable company margin/profit acceleration.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: DDR4 prices rise but company earnings do not accelerate enough to overcome valuation/market expectations.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q3 reporting and product-price/margin updates should expose whether the June shortage converted.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: DDR4 price/supply conditions accelerated sharply in June.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: The company was already profitable/growing, but the June shortage had not yet appeared in a reporting period.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: Peers either had profit declines or losses at the cutoff.

baselineLag.rationale: Q1 earnings predated the June industry price reset and may lag the new physical conditions.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use deterministic 20/60d opportunity-basket regime and peer relative performance.

priceRegime.method: equal-weight frozen memory basket versus CSI300

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: June DDR4 contract/spot prices and supply tightness accelerated.

earningsRevisionBreadth.rationale: Current company earnings were mixed: 兆易创新 positive, 北京君正 down, 江波龙/德明利 loss-making despite recovery expectations.

eventHalfLife.rationale: EOL/capacity reductions are more persistent than a one-off tariff restock.

lateCycleRisk.rationale: 20d breadth turned strong, but 60d breadth remained weak rather than universally crowded.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Physical impulse is strong, but the 60d price/revision regime has not confirmed a broad turn.

qualityFloor.rationale: Positive earnings and operating cash flow clear the quality floor.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: June physical price acceleration may create H2 revision room beyond Q1 run-rate.

valuationSlack.rationale: The company carries a quality premium and no clean cheap-valuation anchor is frozen at cutoff.

catalystReachability.rationale: Q3 earnings/margin updates lie inside the 60d base horizon.

downsideContainment.rationale: If price transmission disappoints, quality alone may not protect against valuation compression.
